latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release—automated, secure GitHub push tool with smart configuration and safety features.

- Auto-configures SSH and git remotes for easy, secure setup.
- Handles conflicts with automatic pull, rebase, and force-push.
- Built-in rate limiting, batching, and validation to prevent bans and accidental misuse.
- Highly configurable via YAML for safety thresholds and operation modes.
- No external dependencies; uses the standard Git CLI.
